SYMPTOM: When NSApplication setActivationPolicy: is called to hide the dock icon (switching to Accessory policy), macOS automatically activates the next app in the window stack — Whisnap settings window disappears into background.

CAUSE: macOS design — switching from Regular to Accessory policy removes the app from the normal activation chain, so the OS refocuses the topmost remaining regular app.

FIX: Immediately after calling set_activation_policy(Accessory), check if the Whisnap window is currently visible, and if so call window.set_focus(). This re-asserts focus before macOS can steal it.

Rust pattern:
```rust
if let Some(window) = app_handle.get_webview_window("main") {
    if window.is_visible().unwrap_or(false) {
        let _ = window.set_focus();
    }
}
```

PREVENT: Any time you toggle activation policy dynamically, always re-focus the intended window immediately after.
